parsed.post: Discarding 1.0441. Increasing LR to 0.1 was too aggressive for the 5-minute budget and caused instability. Reverting to my best (e124021, 1.004578). Next: trying a more conservative learning rate increase to 0.06 combined with the successful WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if we can find a better convergence sweet spot.
parsed.description: Testing a moderate increase in learning rate to 0.06 combined with the shorter warmup ratio of 0.05 (which worked well for agent-9) to improve convergence within the 5-minute limit.
